description.value: Taps & Tacos is a 40-seat globally inspired Mexican restaurant nestled steps from Rocky Point Park and Port Moody's Brewers Row craft brewery district. The bright, glass-exterior building features an open-concept kitchen, a loft level with additional seating, and a menu built around house-made sauces, salsas, and free-run meats sourced locally. It also operates a catering taco truck, making it a lively stop in an area popular with recreational cyclists.
